close_reason: Added 'Clone' to all 10 non-lifetimed public method-input Params/Input structs across the canonical mail-client and 5 sibling extension-client crates: jmap-mail-client (5: EmailGetParams, EmailCopyParams, MailboxSetParams, EmailSubmissionSetParams, EmailParseParams), jmap-calendars-client (2: CalendarEventParseParams, PrincipalGetAvailabilityParams — CalendarEventGetParams already had Clone), jmap-contacts-client (1: AddressBookSetParams), jmap-filenode-client (2: FileNodeSetParams, FileNodeCopyParams), jmap-chat-client (2: ChatQueryInput, ChatContactQueryInput). jmap-tasks-client and jmap-sharing-client have no Params structs in their public method-input surface; jmap-metadata-client side tracked separately at JMAP-wzq9.34 (5 Params there). Borrowed-lifetime *Input structs (EmailImportInput<'a> on mail-client + 19 *Input<'a> on chat-client) explicitly scoped out per the bead body's carve-out and tracked in follow-up JMAP-tjvm.39 for the canonical-template completion. Workspace canonical-template propagation rule followed.
description:
Canonical mail-client analog of JMAP-wzq9.20 / JMAP-wzq9.34 (metadata-client).

`crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/mod.rs`:

    line 40:  #[derive(Debug, Default, serde::Serialize)]
    line 42:  pub struct EmailGetParams { ... }

    line 67:  #[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize)]
    line 69:  pub struct EmailCopyParams { ... }

    line 87:  #[derive(Debug, Default, serde::Serialize)]
    line 89:  pub struct MailboxSetParams { ... }

    line 111: #[derive(Debug, Default, serde::Serialize)]
    line 113: pub struct EmailSubmissionSetParams { ... }

    line 253: #[derive(Debug, Default, serde::Serialize)]
    line 255: pub struct EmailParseParams { ... }

None of the five public input param structs derive `Clone`. (`EmailImportInput<'a>` at line 147 also lacks it but holds borrowed data, so Clone is separately debatable — not the concern here.)

## What goes wrong

The five methods all take `Option<XxxParams>` by value. A caller running a paginated changes/query loop or a parallel fan-out cannot reuse the same params object:

    let params = EmailGetParams { fetch_text_body_values: Some(true), .. Default::default() };
    for chunk in id_chunks {
        let resp = sc.email_get(Some(chunk), None, Some(params.clone())).await?;
        //                                                ^^^^^^^^ does not compile
        ...
    }

The caller must either:
- Construct a fresh `EmailGetParams` every iteration (materialising any `Vec<String>` body_properties from scratch each time), or
- Wrap params in `Rc` / `Arc` and `.clone()` the smart pointer (extra ceremony just to reuse a config object).

## Fix

Add `Clone` to all 5 derives:

    #[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, serde::Serialize)]   // EmailGetParams, MailboxSetParams, EmailSubmissionSetParams, EmailParseParams
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]            // EmailCopyParams (no Default since from_account_id is required)

Cost: `Clone` of `Vec<String>` body_properties is O(n) on element count, but n is bounded by the spec's enumerated property names (small). Acceptable.

## Cross-refs

- JMAP-wzq9.20 — metadata-client side: MetadataChangesParams not Clone
- JMAP-wzq9.34 — metadata-client side: the 4 new params structs missing Clone
- JMAP-tjvm.16 — adjacent `#[non_exhaustive]` gap on the same structs (different concern, both should be fixed in same commit)

## Workspace propagation

Per workspace AGENTS.md "Canonical Templates", fix here first, then propagate to all 7 extension-client siblings.
title: Public input params structs missing Clone derive (EmailGetParams, EmailCopyParams, MailboxSetParams, EmailSubmissionSetParams, EmailParseParams)
